title: RC-22 base fee doubled: maxFeePerGas - maxPriorityFeePerGas from ethers getFeeData() is exactly 2x the latest base fee, so the affordability and sell-reserve math over-reserves; buys are refused early (safe) and on a thin wallet the private sell is refused before submit and the exit goes to the public mempool

evidence.note: maxPriorityFeePerGas = priorityFee ?? 1 gwei; maxFeePerGas = block.baseFeePerGas * 2 + maxPriorityFeePerGas, with block = latest (:601)
baseFeeWei = feeData.maxFeePerGas - feeData.maxPriorityFeePerGas, i.e. 2 x latest base fee
deriveFeeWei uses the same derivation for the buy-time entry gate (sibling, DB/CONFIG-adjacent file)
reserve = sellGasLimit x (baseFeeWei x 1.5) = 3 x the real base fee per gas
headroom = balance - value - reserve - gasLimit x baseFeeWei; headroom <= 0 -> unaffordable, the strategy throws before submitting (:527-543)

the submitted maxFeePerGas = baseFeeWei + priority: here the 2x is the usual ethers headroom against a rising base fee, which helps inclusion and is not an overspend (EIP-1559 charges the real base fee)
a strategy throw on the sell leg becomes landed:false with an empty broadcast handle
executeFullSell then skips guard 2a (no hash) and goes to the balance check and the public-mempool fallback

sibling_sites_checked: All four derivations: flashbots.ts:169-172, passthrough.ts:63-66, preflight.ts:314-330 (deriveFeeWei), and the doc comments at reconciliation.ts:234/:255. bloxroute.ts:92 uses gasPrice (BSC legacy), so BSC is not doubled. The public fallback itself (exitEngine.ts:552-555) uses ethers default fees and is never refused by the bot; only the node can refuse it for insufficient funds.
severity_rationale: S2, equal to the research suggestion. Direction measured from code: the doubled base fee only ever over-reserves. It never lets a buy spend more than configured and never blocks an exit outright. Its capital effect is indirect: a buy that is affordable can be refused, and on a thin wallet (balance between about gasLimit x (2 x base + tip) and gasLimit x (5 x base + tip)) the private sell is refused before submit and the position is sold on the public mempool, where it can be sandwiched; private sells accept any output (AUD-EXIT-001). It also lowers the clamped private priority fee (headroom / gasLimit), which lowers private inclusion odds.
recommendation: Phase 24 (card TX-02): use the real base fee (latest block baseFeePerGas, optionally projected one block ahead) for affordability and the sell reserve, keep 2 x base + tip only as the submitted maxFeePerGas cap, and do the same in preflight deriveFeeWei. Decide whether the sell leg should reserve gas at all (AUD-TX-010).
